candidates.change_summary: Remove the withdraw call inside withdrawAll so nothing is transferred
Replace call to withdraw with a transfer of 0 ether so the balance stays unchanged
Delete the entire onlyOwner modifier body to remove access control
Remove the require check so anyone can call functions with this modifier
Replace transfer with selfdestruct to prevent balance decrease while allowing withdrawal call to complete
Remove the transfer so contract balance does not change after withdraw call
Remove require check in modifier so anyone can call withdraw, changing balance behavior
Remove the require statement that checks the call success, so sendMoney always completes even when the external call fails.
Replace the call with a transfer, changing the failure mode and gas stipend which can alter the outcome of the sendMoney call.
Change the onlyOwner modifier to always pass, removing the access control so non-owners can call sendMoney.
Move the depositsCount increment from fallback into sendMoney, so depositsCount changes only on intentional sendMoney calls instead of accidental ETH sends.
